The rain will have a significant impact on the traffic, particularly on the Nnamdi Azikiwe Expressway, where drivers can expect reduced visibility and slower traffic speeds. Residents living in low-lying areas, such as the flood-prone zones near the airport road, should be prepared for potential flooding and take necessary precautions to protect their properties. The models suggest that the rain will be most intense during the late afternoon, around 4 pm, with a brief lull in the early evening, before resuming again around 8 pm. However, this will be short-lived, as the low-pressure system will continue to dominate the weather, leading to an increase in humidity and precipitation. My best guess is that the rain will clear out by around 10 pm, leaving behind a mostly cloudy sky and a temperature of around 23°C.
